YouTube is the world's largest video sharing site, that the uploading behavior of its users is positively correlated to their social behavior, and that a majority of the videos on YouTube is user generated.

YouTube is a large-scale social network of users who upload videos to each other, with a significant portion of videos uploaded being copied from other sites, and that the uploading behavior of users is positively reinforced by the social behavior of users.
YouTube uploaders are a large and active population of users, and that the majority of videos uploaded to YouTube are original content created by YouTube users.

the understanding and characterization of YouTube uploaders.
the social behavior of YouTube uploaders and the impact of this behavior on YouTube.
the study of the YouTube phenomenon and the YouTube uploaders.
